title: Miami 21 Zoning
description: The purpose of this layer is to provide users with a spatial representation of the Transect Zones, in the Miami 21 (form-based) zoning code, and their consolidated amendments in the City of Miami. Transects are areas of varying Density whose character is determined by the requirements for Use, Height, Setback and Building Form. This dataset is comprised of boundary geometry representing transect zones of the Miami 21 Zoning code currently in force and effect. Updates are performed regularly by the Planning Department.
